profile.name: 网络套接字客户端
profile.description: 这不是一台特定的实验仪器，而是一个用于与网络化实验设备保持开放套接字连接的通用客户端。它可连接指定地址和端口，发送文本命令、接收返回消息并读取日志流，常用于远程控制数据采集系统或其他基于网络接口的实验设备。
profile.description_en: This is not a specific laboratory instrument, but a generic client for maintaining an open socket connection to networked lab equipment. It connects to a specified address and port, sends text commands, receives returned messages, and reads log streams, making it useful for remote control of data acquisition systems or other instruments with network interfaces.

registry.name: Connects and holds open a socket to defined port
registry.description: Netclient是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、运行。支持Signal, Slot, addr等操作。
